name: WF-99: AgriSensa Global Error Handler & Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO workflow_error_logs (
    workflow_id,
    workflow_name,
    execution_id,
    node_name,
    error_message,
    error_stack,
    input_data,
    severity,
    alert_sent
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.workflow_id }}',
    '{{ $json.workflow_name_sql }}',
    '{{ $json.execution_id }}',
    '{{ $json.node_name_sql }}',
    '{{ $json.error_message_sql }}',
    '{{ $json.error_stack_sql }}',
    '{{ $json.input_data_sql }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $json.severity }}',
    true
) RETURNING id;

meta.description: WF-99: Global Error Handler & Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) - Captures execution failures across all workflows, persists audit diagnostics to PostgreSQL, and dispatches multi-channel alerts (Telegram & API Webhook)
